title: docs(pm-dispatch): make the stop-condition clause carry the executability criterion
body:
Fixes #14031

Governed surface (`.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`) — **draft only, human merge**. No AI seat merges, queues, or arms auto-merge on this PR.

## The ruling this executes

Director seat comment 5507668202 (2026-09-02), option **A**. Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #4 in which this card was item 2 with recommendation A. Verbatim and untranslated — 「其他同意」 is what adopts A:

> 「13973 帮我综合分析，并参考主流平台的方案，并给我解释为什么不能都用日期类型。其他同意」

Ruled: the ratchet ceiling for `references/dispatch-runbook.md` is raised at the landed count, and the executability criterion plus the two executable rewrite forms land as the **merged** bullet — prose, no table row. Options B, C, D, E are not taken; D (funding growth by deleting sibling rules' rationale) is refused on the standing ruling. Nothing here is re-decided.

## The bullet, before and after

**Before** (3 lines) — it fixed *who adjudicates* a fork, but said nothing about whether the addressee can execute the fence at all:

```
- **停条件写法:
  要证据,不要判决**。派发令里的前提/停条件检查必须要 dev 回报**证据面**(搜了什么、
  找到什么),分叉归 PM 判 —— 写成「发现消费者就停下」把判决权交回被停的一方。
```

**After** (6 lines) — the criterion is merged into the same bullet, so neither it nor the templates can be copied without the other:

```
- **停条件写法:要证据不要判决,且动作须在本轮内终局**。前提/停条件检查要 dev 回报**证
  据面**(搜了什么、找到什么),分叉归 PM 判 —— 写成「发现消费者就停下」把判决权交回
  被停的一方。可执行性判据:一次性 dev 无中途提问的通道,「先问再继续」预设了不存在的
  续接,把照做并报告/不做/自行裁断三选一(非二选一)整个交给本想被围住的人。两种改写
  都在一轮内闭合:允许做 ⇒「只做**最小**编辑,并在报告里单列该判断与回退方式」;不许
  做 ⇒「⛔ 不要动该文件,让门禁红着并在报告里点名该站点」。
```

It carries all three required parts: **(a)** the executability criterion — a fence clause is executable by a one-shot dev only if the action it demands is terminal within the run; "ask first, then continue" presupposes a channel the dev does not have and hands the whole choice (do and report / don't / decide alone — **three ways, not two**, per the triage's wording rule) to the executor the author thought they had fenced. **(b)** the two executable rewrite forms, with the reason they work (both close within one run). **(c)** the existing bullet's own rule, kept intact.

## Line arithmetic — read from the gate's own verdict lines, not counted by hand

| | verdict line |
|:--|:--|
| before | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md is 277 lines (ceiling 278; headroom 1).` |
| after | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md is 280 lines (ceiling 280; headroom 0).` |
| table row (unchanged) | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md: widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0).` |

The merged bullet is 668 logical bytes; the gate's own `wrapLine` wraps it to **6 lines**, replacing the 3-line bullet — net **+3**, landing at **280**. The ceiling row moves `278 -> 280` at the landed count, headroom 0, the file's convention. The widest-table-row pin stays at **0**, which is exactly what forecloses the compact two-row table the card and its triage both used and forces the forms into prose.

**Union re-derived after the last edit**, no hand-fed paths: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` — `gate list derived from the tree of 'objectstack-ai/objectstack' at commit 077c86a4`, `--repo ... checked against this checkout's 'origin' remote — it holds`, change set `2 path(s) vs merge base bd4aa4e49`. It named 20 commands; the 13 beyond the dispatched list were run too, all green:

`check-ci-filter-parity` · `check-cross-package-test-inputs` (both spellings) · `check-shard-attestation` · `bare-root-worklist --self-test` · `check:agent-test-spelling` · `check:bash32-floor` · `check:cli-command-ids` · `check:doc-authoring` · `check:entry-guard` · `check:parse-guard` · `check:pnpm-filter-targets` · `check:watch-hint-literal` · `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`.

Because the diff edits a gate script, the two other scripts that read the ratchet were run as well — `check-published-list-mirrors` (`OK: 1 published list mirror(s) match their constants line for line.`) and `check-skills-token-ratchet` (`✓ 31 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`).

**One command in the union is NOT MEASURED, and is not reported as green:** `check-test-completeness` exits 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate grades a saved 'turbo run test' log, and no log was named.` It grades a log only a CI test run produces. `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-shard-attestation` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` also first exited 3 on missing prerequisites (`node_modules`, then unbuilt `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint`); all three were re-measured green after `pnpm install` and the targeted builds, and only their green re-runs are claimed above.

## `skip-changeset`

Releases nothing, verified against `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`'s own enumeration — `It releases nothing (.github/, .claude/, skills/, docs/, content/, examples/, tests-only, and the like)`. The diff is one `.claude/` protocol file plus one CI-internal gate script, which that file separately calls "the textbook case for that label". No `needs:contract-review`.

## premise_false

- **The dispatch sized the deliverable at "about 580 bytes, 5 lines" and "net +2 lines at most".** The honest merged bullet carrying every ruled part measures 668 bytes and wraps to 6 lines — net **+3**. The source of the discrepancy is an internal inconsistency in the earlier dev report, which is reproduced here rather than resolved by hand: its floor line says "5 lines ... net +2, final 279 lines" while its option A says "Raise the ceiling 278 to 280". The ruling adopted 280. Landing at the measured count reconciles the two: the bullet lands at 280 and the ceiling is set to 280, so the ruled number and the measured number agree. The dispatch's own escape hatch governs — "the ruling authorizes the raise to the landed count of the merged bullet, not a number". Nothing was padded to reach 280 and nothing was cut to reach 279.
- **The container's REST channel is closed for this seat.** Every repo-scoped REST read returned 403 while `/rate_limit` reported 15000/hour (credential alive, session-gated). The card was read through the zero-quota public-repo payload channel; the newest comment — the ruling itself — was not in that page, so one targeted MCP `issue_read get_comments` call was spent on it. Channel switch declared.

Everything else in the dispatch held: the probe branch carried no unmerged commits (`git log origin/main..origin/claude/issue-14031-executable-fence-forms` empty) before the `--force-with-lease` rebuild; `origin/main` did not move on the hot file, so no merge of `main` was needed; the ceiling row was where the dispatch said it was, and the comment block above it was mirrored in style.
